full_prompt_en: This is a square, restrained oil-style portrait of a pale adult woman seated against a mottled gray wall. She occupies the center in a view from the lap upward, dressed almost entirely in black. A broad, flat-brimmed hat stretches across the upper part of the frame and casts a soft dark arc around her pale face. Beneath it, her hair is tucked away; the straight nose, light eyes, and small closed mouth give her an unsmiling, composed expression. A dark jacket with a high, narrow lapel and a black necktie or scarf forms a long vertical shape down the chest. Her hands rest together in her lap near the lower left, lightly illuminated against the mass of dark clothing. The chair is barely distinguishable from her dress and the shadow near the right side, allowing the figure to appear embedded in the surrounding gray-black field. The background has no furniture or readable marks, only broad rubbed strokes in warm charcoal, taupe, and cool gray. Soft frontal light from slightly above clarifies her face and fingers; clothing and lower body lose detail as they merge into shadow. The edges of the hat and shoulders are firm enough to anchor the silhouette, while the wall and dark garments show brushed, dry-looking transitions. Color is almost absent, with subtle warmth in skin and muted brown-gray on the background. The posture is still and symmetrical except for the hands placed toward one side. The overall composition is austere and elegant, using a pale face and hands as measured accents within a broad matte darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、克制的油画式肖像，一位肤色苍白的成年女子坐在斑驳灰墙前。她从膝部以上居中入画，几乎全身穿黑。宽而平的帽檐横过上部，在浅色面容周围投下柔和深色弧线。帽下头发收起；笔直的鼻子、浅色双眼与小而闭合的嘴使神情不带笑意却很镇定。深色夹克有高而窄的翻领，黑色领带或围巾在胸前形成绵长竖形。双手在左下附近搭在膝上，在大片深色衣服前接到轻微亮光。椅子几乎不能与裙装和右侧阴影区分，使人物仿佛嵌进周围灰黑画域。背景没有家具或可读标记，只有暖炭色、灰褐和冷灰的宽阔擦磨笔痕。略高处的柔和正面光照清面孔与手指；衣服和下半身在并入阴影时失去细节。帽子与肩部边缘足够明确，固定剪影，墙壁与深色衣物则有刷笔、略干涩的过渡。色彩几乎消失，只有皮肤的微暖和背景上低调的褐灰。姿态静止，大体对称，只有双手置于一侧。整体构图冷峻而优雅，以浅色面孔和双手作为宽大哑光黑暗中的有节制强调。
style_prompt_en: The oil-painted treatment is nearly monochrome, built from charcoal, warm gray, taupe, and narrow pale accents. Large matte dark areas hold the frame together, while soft frontal light reveals selected smooth planes. Broad dry-looking brush marks and rubbed transitions give the ground physical texture without demanding a detailed setting. Firm outer contours contrast with garments that merge into nearby shadow. The composition favors stillness, a centered vertical axis, and a few light shapes placed well apart within dark mass. Color warmth is subtle, so tonal contrast and edge control carry the image. The overall effect is elegant, introspective, and spare, with detail withheld as deliberately as it is given.
style_prompt_zh: 这种油画处理近乎单色，以炭黑、暖灰、灰褐和狭窄浅色强调构成。宽大的哑光暗域维系画面，柔和正面光只揭示选择性的平滑平面。宽而略干的笔痕与擦磨过渡赋予底面实体肌理，无需详尽场景。明确的外轮廓与融入邻近阴影的深色区域相对。构图偏向静止、居中的竖轴和几处在深色体量中彼此拉开的浅形。色彩暖意细微，因此明度反差与边缘控制承担图像。整体效果优雅、内省而简净，细节的省略与呈现同样经过安排。
theme_en: A pale woman in a broad black hat seated against a gray wall
theme_zh: 一位苍白女子戴宽边黑帽，坐在灰色墙前
name: Romaine Brooks
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
